name: Piano
description: Facts about the instrument, plus originals lines for solo pianists.
curatedFacts: A standard piano has 88 keys: 52 white and 36 black.
Middle C is the C nearest the middle of the piano keyboard.
The word "piano" is short for pianoforte, Italian for "soft-loud".
A concert grand piano has around 230 strings under roughly 20 tons of combined tension.
originalsFacts: Writing for solo piano means every line has to carry itself; there's no band to hide behind.
